title: Task Result — Writer Extension
description: Role-specific fields for Writer returns. Used in addition to the common task-result envelope.

claims.description: Every substantive factual claim in the output, traced to its source.

source.description: Artifact path, URL, or database reference supporting this claim.

location.description: Location in the article where this claim appears, e.g. 'paragraph 3' or line range.

source_mappings.description: Mapping from each input artifact to how it was used.

additionalProperties.description: Artifact path or task_id mapped to usage, e.g. 'used for statistics in paragraphs 2-4'.

editorial_constraints.description: Editorial decisions or constraints that affected the output.

publication_readiness.description: Writer's own assessment of whether this is publishable.
